facts.fact: Mali's digital minister took part in the opening of the fourth SIPEN-UEMOA digital economy fair in Ouagadougou and delivered the address on behalf of the AES Confederation's digital ministers; no agreement was signed, a Declaration of Ouagadougou was only anticipated.
